prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1082; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center with the left taillight assembly broken, and the trunk lid shows a crease consistent with the reported rear impact. The damage pattern lines up well with how the collision was described, and nothing I found suggests earlier damage to this vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing the trunk lid, and checking the rear sensors. Labor hours on the estimate run slightly high for this scope of work, so I recommend a line-by-line review with the shop. The invoices provided show no repeated charges.
